name: Kukoo2
description: Type One's intro for the Pleasure Access BBS, with AdLib music
author: Type One of The FLamoots
contentNote: Contains nudity in its archive only: PA.BBS, a text-art BBS banner that is mostly a picture of a nude woman, which the intro never shows.

start.note: Its CGA pre-intro plays first, with the Belgian anthem on the PC speaker; once it rests, the Space DosKit presses takes it on to its VGA part.

hint: Kukoo2 waits at the end of its pre-intro: press Space for its VGA part.
